title: Expose owner-only visit calendar and detail read model
requirements: Add an explicitly injected owner-only visit read runtime and GET /api/v1/admin/visits plus GET /api/v1/admin/visits/{id}. Both endpoints use the existing valid owner session boundary, return 401 AUTH_REQUIRED without CRM data for an absent or invalid session, are read-only and do not require CSRF. Do not add a production runtime composition.

The calendar list requires UTC from and to moments, uses from inclusive and to exclusive, rejects a malformed, empty or reversed interval as INVALID_REQUEST, and returns 422 RANGE_TOO_LARGE when the interval exceeds 93 days. It supports an opaque cursor bound to from/to and limit with default 50 and range 1..100. Stable ascending start_at/id order and limit-plus-one pagination are required.

Select visits that intersect the requested interval rather than only visits that start inside it. A visit with known duration intersects when start_at < to and end_at > from. A visit with unknown duration is selected by start_at in the interval and is returned with end_at null; no end time may be invented.

Each VisitSummary contains exactly id, version, status, service_title, start_at, duration_minutes, end_at, inquiry_count, participants_count and has_unresolved_inquiries. Count only current participations (closed_at is null); participants_count is their summed inquiry_terms participants_count; has_unresolved_inquiries is true when a current participation has an inquiry status other than COMPLETED or CANCELLED. Do not expose contacts, comments, cash-note lines, catalog internals or allowed commands in the list.

Visit detail returns a consistent owner-only projection of the plan and every current participation: participation id, inquiry id/version/status, participants_count, requester_name and calculated effective-cash summary, plus allowed_commands as an empty list until write handlers exist. Unknown or malformed IDs return 404 without a database error body. Do not silently truncate participations.

Read every list page and detail through a PostgreSQL READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ transaction. Reuse the accepted effective-cash semantics: only non-superseded notes count, and a return larger than receipts gives calculation_warning DATA_REVIEW_REQUIRED without writing an aggregate.

Add synthetic PostgreSQL integration tests for session protection, range intersection including unknown duration, 93-day guard, cursor/filter binding, summary privacy and counts, detail participation/cash data, and 404. Tests create isolated random databases and never read a local .env or use a configured source database.
Do not add visit or inquiry writes, status commands, payment integrations, catalog editing, frontend calendar assets, bot adapters, secrets or external calls.
acceptance: A signed-in owner can read an accurate paged calendar and open a visit card with its current group composition; a visitor cannot obtain these data.
Calendar intervals faithfully represent known and unknown duration facts and do not mix a group composition or cash result from different database moments.
Focused isolated PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted owner-only calendar projection of existing visit, participation, inquiry and cash facts; it introduces no write path.
